title: Perfect
lyrics:
[00:00.00] 制作人 : Ed Sheeran/Will Hicks
[00:00.94] 作词 : Ed Sheeran
[00:01.88] 作曲 : Ed Sheeran
[00:02.83]I found a love for me
[00:07.97]Darling, just dive right in and follow my lead
[00:17.84]Well, I found a girl, beautiful and sweet
[00:25.62]Oh, I never knew you were the someone waiting for me
[00:32.33]'Cause we were just kids when we fell in love
[00:36.53]Not knowing what it was
[00:40.33]I will not give you up this time
[00:47.86]darling, just kiss me slow, your heart is all I own
[00:55.35]And in your eyes you're holding mine
[01:02.40]Baby, I'm dancing in the dark with you between my arms
[01:13.09]Barefoot on the grass, listening to our favourite song
[01:20.62]When you said you looked a mess, I whispered underneath my breath
[01:27.85]But you heard it, darling, you look perfect tonight
[01:35.57]
[01:41.54]Well I found a woman, stronger than anyone I know
[01:47.89]She shares my dreams, I hope that someday I'll share her home
[01:55.95]I found a love, to carry more than just my secrets
[02:03.76]To carry love, to carry children of our own
[02:10.98]We are still kids, but we're so in love
[02:15.17]Fighting against all odds
[02:18.85]I know we'll be alright this time
[02:26.41]Darling, just hold my hand
[02:30.26]Be my girl, I'll be your man
[02:33.99]I see my future in your eyes
[02:40.63]Baby, I'm dancing in the dark, with you between my arms
[02:51.45]Barefoot on the grass, listening to our favourite song
[02:59.05]When I saw you in that dress, looking so beautiful
[03:05.97]I don't deserve this, darling you look perfect tonight
[03:16.72]
[03:19.92]Baby, I'm dancing in the dark, with you between my arms
[03:36.85]Barefoot on the grass, listening to our favourite song
[03:44.62]I have faith in what I see
[03:47.93]Now I know I have met an angel in person
[03:54.46]And she looks perfect, I don't deserve this
[04:02.28]You look perfect tonight
[04:07.32]
